instrumentation.baseline: usedJSHeapSize sampled before the application opens the retained Project
instrumentation.current: usedJSHeapSize sampled at evidence capture after viewer completion
instrumentation.peak: maximum usedJSHeapSize observed by 250 ms interval and evidence-triggered samples
instrumentation.retainedDelta: current minus baseline; signed value preserved

configurationEvidence.source: Project Owner confirmation in the controlled Chrome session
configurationEvidence.method: Chrome DevTools Performance panel, Capture settings, CPU 4x slowdown
configurationEvidence.targetContinuity: The reference medium tab was retained, claimed unchanged after owner confirmation, and navigated only to a new evidence-run identifier for the constrained capture.

limitations: The browser evidence API does not expose the active DevTools CPU multiplier; constrained configuration depends on Project Owner confirmation and preserved target continuity.
DevTools CPU throttling is relative to the host and is not a claim about a specific mobile CPU architecture.
Chromium usedJSHeapSize is a process main-thread signal and excludes Worker, Canvas, and GPU allocation.
No forced garbage collection was available; signed retained deltas are preserved without clamping or reinterpretation.
These artifacts do not measure import-Worker peak memory.
